the knowledge that teachers must have to effectively use technology for learning.
the development of a framework for teacher knowledge that can be used to describe, design, select, and enact the use of the new tools that are now available for teaching and learning in our schools.

the development of TPACK in teachers is critical to their effective use of technology in the teaching and learning process.

, Technological pedagogical content Knowledge (TPACK) is a framework that helps teachers to understand the complex nature of technology integration in the classroom.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the TPACK framework has been developed and used to guide the development of technology integration curricula, and has been used to guide the design of technology integration professional development.
TPACK is the knowledge required by teachers to effectively integrate technology into their teaching.
teachers need to develop knowledge about how to teach with technology, and that this knowledge is more than the sum of its parts.
The main takeaway from our work is that
technology is not an isolated body of knowledge that teachers can acquire and use independently from other bodies of knowledge.
technology integration is a complex process that requires a sophisticated understanding of how technology, content, and pedagogy are intertwined.
technology integration is not just a matter of adding a new tool or technique to a teacher's pedagogical arsenal.
